## How to Verify

```bash
# 1. Start the backend
cd backend && mvn spring-boot:run

# 2. Test the discount field via curl
curl http://localhost:8080/api/products | jq '.[0].discount'
# Expected: 0.15

# 3. Create a product with discount
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/products \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Demo","price":19.99,"discount":0.20,"category":"TEST","stock":5,"sku":"DEMO-001"}'

# 4. Run all unit tests
cd backend && mvn test
```
